agent.definition: A system in which a model decides, in a loop, which actions (tool calls) to take toward a goal, and when it is done.

tool.definition: A function, API or service an agent can call to read data or take an action. The model asks for the call; the runtime runs it.

workflow.definition: A fixed sequence of steps, possibly with model calls inside, whose order the designer set in advance.

determinism spectrum.definition: The range from fully scripted flows, where the designer decides every step, to autonomous agents, where the model does.
